observations: Consolidation quality improves when bounded mechanism success is recorded separately from unchanged task, user-level, and upper-objective failure.
Candidate proposals must be preserved with their scope, required gate, inactive state, contradictory evidence, and rollback rule.

result.claim_boundary: The PASS applies only to the merged O-native matched-evidence acquisition guard and its declared synthetic controls. It does not establish evidence quality, cross-domain generalization, autonomous self-improvement, production reliability, AGI, upper-objective completion, user-level completion, or monitor completion.
result.episode_summary: The generation-29 unit implemented and verified an O-native Learn-to-Root guard that schedules one same-capability evidence-acquisition attempt only for the sole typed MISSING_SAME_CAPABILITY_EVIDENCE condition, fails closed under seven declared negative-control classes, suppresses duplicate replay, and returns to ordinary Root selection. Independent Task Evaluate marked that exact repository-local mechanism unit PASS while leaving the user-level and upper AGI objectives FAIL. Post-result Candidate Evaluate proposed a separately gated scoped evaluator change but performed no activation. The episode remains open for Learn, Root, materially different capability work, and strict independent external AGI evidence.

evaluator_verdicts.reason: The repository-local guard satisfies its exact declared contract, but it does not establish the unchanged AGI/user objective.
